title: Complete reached CICS operations and unit-of-work semantics
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of cics_runtime_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: All 240 reached CICS statements map to 24 executable typed variants; the former ASKTIME, FORMATTIME, INQUIRE, and SYNCPOINT unsupported boundary is removed without accepting unknown opcodes.

The scoped clock returns bounded UTC calendar values; ASKTIME produces exact CICS milliseconds since 1900 and FORMATTIME populates all seven reached date, time, separator, and millisecond destination forms.

ASSIGN, LINK, RETRIEVE, nested/subscripted operands, local condition handlers, HANDLE ABEND/CANCEL, NOHANDLE, and all 26 MAP, nine TEXT, and five plain FROM SEND forms preserve typed storage and control identities.
RETURN TRANSID persists 24 reached COMMAREA continuations with compare-and-swap claim/replay behavior; entry DFHCOMMAREA bytes and transient-data queue records survive provider restart.

SYNCPOINT commit and both reached ROLLBACK forms persist intent before result. Final replay is idempotent; an intent without a result remains UnknownOutcome across restart until explicit reconciliation. Infrastructure failure is never converted to NOHANDLE success.

commands.result: focused pre-repair regression proved ASKTIME was explicitly unsupported
